## GREEN (G)

The Successor function for Church Numerals. Increments a numeral `n` by applying
the function `f` one more time.

## BLUE (B)

```typescript
/**
 * SUCC: Numeric Increment
 */
export const ATOM = () => (n: any) => (f: any) => (x: any) => f(n(f)(x));
```
